# Alfred Panakkal Jose — Portfolio & Projects Summary for AI Agents

> Alfred Panakkal Jose (@capt-alfred) is a seafarer by profession and a full-stack developer by passion. He builds free, high-utility web tools and open-source applications connecting maritime navigation with modern technology.

## Core Identity
- **Name**: Alfred Panakkal Jose
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/capt-alfred
- **Role**: Third Officer, Full-Stack Software Developer, Open Source Creator
- **Email**: alpha.coil966@passinbox.com
- **Core Skills**: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Tailwind CSS, Maritime Software Engineering

## Featured Projects & Applications

### 1. Helm Almanac
- **URL**: https://helm-almanac.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/Helm-Almanac
- **Description**: A comprehensive maritime almanac application for tracking vessel schedules, nautical events, and navigational reference data.
- **Technologies**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS

### 2. Helm Productivity
- **URL**: https://helmproductivity.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/The-Helm---Productivity-app
- **Description**: A minimalist productivity suite engineered for seafarers and developers to manage watchkeeping, tasks, and routines effectively.
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Vercel

### 3. Helm Bond (Bond Vault)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/BOND-VAULT
- **Description**: A specialized networking platform connecting maritime professionals, shipping agencies, and maritime officers worldwide.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, Socket.io, PostgreSQL

### 4. Helm Fasting
- **URL**: https://helmfasting.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/The-Helm-Fasting
- **Description**: A dedicated health and intermittent fasting companion designed to maintain fitness goals during long ocean voyages.
- **Technologies**: React, PWA, Chart.js

### 5. Mudhra Converter
- **URL**: https://mudhra-converter.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/MUDHRA.CONVERTER
- **Description**: A fast currency and unit conversion application designed for intuitive everyday transactions.
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

### 6. Navarea Warning Plotter
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/Navarea-warning---plotter
- **Description**: Maritime navigational safety tool for plotting NAVAREA navigation warnings and hazard zones.
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, React, Maps/Geospatial

### 7. Seafarer NRI & Seatime Calculator
- **Repository**: https://github.com/capt-alfred/seafarer-calculator-nri-seatime-calc
- **Description**: Dedicated calculator for seafarers to track sea time days, NRI tax exemption status, and voyage contracts.
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, React, LocalStorage
